gates.name: Build documentation
gates.reason: ./docs.ps1 is not present in this checkout (Test-Path docs.ps1 returned False). It is installed by Invoke-SetupDocs rather than committed, so the production Docusaurus build — the only gate that resolves routes and heading anchors under onBrokenLinks: 'throw' — cannot be run here. Docker is available; the script is not. The Verify Documentation Build check on the pull request is where this answer comes from.

gates.name: Merge landing page into documentation build
gates.reason: npm --prefix site run merge requires a completed docs build in artifacts/docs. That directory exists but is left over from an earlier run, not produced by this one, because the Build documentation gate above could not run. Merging into a stale artifact would report a verdict on an input this branch never produced.

gates.name: Test the host
gates.reason: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests requires NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN for the sibling-repo GitHub Packages feed (src/host/nuget.config expands %NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN% at restore time). The variable is not set in this environment and supplying a credential is not this command's to do. The host-image workflow on the pull request is where this answer comes from.

gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: Building the host image requires the same NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN restore as 'Test the host', so the image the curl probes for /, /roadmap/, /docs/, /health/live and /health/ready would run against cannot be built here. Docker itself is running; the credential is what is missing.

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.reason: docker build -f tools/host-smoke/Dockerfile.negative-fixture depends on the same host image build, and therefore on the same absent NUGET_GITHUB_TOKEN restore. The fixture file is present; the build it corrupts cannot be produced locally.
